offering_description.value: FreightCar America builds freight railcars for railroads, leasing companies and industrial shippers. It manufactures railcars in Mexico and supplies replacement parts for its own cars and those built by other manufacturers.

primary_products.value: hopper cars; gondola cars; flatcars; boxcars; railcar replacement parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: freight railroads, railcar leasing companies, industrial shippers and railcar repair shops

end_markets.value: freight rail transportation; agriculture; mining and aggregates; metals and scrap; intermodal shipping

revenue_model.value: product sales: new freight railcars and replacement parts; project or contract: rebuilding and converting existing freight railcars

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds freight cars from steel and purchased components for railroads, shippers and leasing companies; component supplier: supplies fabricated, cast and forged replacement parts to railcar owners and repair shops; service provider: rebuilds and converts existing railcars for fleet owners
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider

geography_served.value: North America: serves the North American freight rail market and manufactures in Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: multiple freight railcar types, replacement parts and railcar rebuilding

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: railcar orders from fleet buyers and aftermarket parts orders from operators and repair shops

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: freight car design and construction are subject to Federal Railroad Administration safety rules and Association of American Railroads standards

notes: The current scale of the railcar rebuilding and conversion business is uncertain.
